title: Lamb Tacos
description: A spicy lamb dish inspired by the flavors of Ethiopia, served in a traditional Mexican taco.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the spice blend, cumin, and cayenne pepper (if using) and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lime juice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the liquid has almost completely evaporated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm tacos shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by placing the lamb mixture onto a shell and topping with cilantro.
